summary: Fresh public main did not ignore the private .local directory used by the Pages packager, exposing its output manifest and synthetic regression artifacts to accidental staging.
evidence: Fresh sparse delivery git status reported untracked .local/ after the generic packager tests. Existing business checkout ignore behavior was not present on public main.
rollback: Revert only the public /.local/ ignore line; preserved private outputs remain outside the served asset tree and are never added to Git.
